python-env-cpu.name: Local AI Engine (CPU)
python-env-cpu.description: Installs the Python environment optimized for CPU execution. Includes PyTorch CPU, ONNX Runtime CPU, and all TTS dependencies.

python-env-gpu.name: Local AI Engine (NVIDIA GPU)
python-env-gpu.description: Installs the Python environment with CUDA-enabled PyTorch for GPU-accelerated TTS on NVIDIA GPUs. Requires an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 12+ support.

python-env-rocm.name: Local AI Engine (AMD GPU)
python-env-rocm.description: Installs the Python environment with ROCm-enabled PyTorch for GPU-accelerated TTS on AMD GPUs. Requires an AMD GPU with ROCm 6+ support.

tts-model.name: Kokoro TTS Model
tts-model.description: Kokoro ONNX neural TTS model with 54 built-in voices. Lightweight and fast.

gallery-avatars.name: 3D Gallery Avatars
gallery-avatars.description: Pre-installed anime-style avatars ready to use immediately.
